articles.title: A Map War Is Changing Who Gets Elected — Here's Why It Matters
articles.summary: States are redrawing voting maps to favor one party. Tennessee wants to split up its only Democratic district in Memphis. Experts say this could mean fewer fair elections.

articles.title: Trump Is Giving D.C. a Makeover — From a Blue Pool to a Giant Arch
articles.summary: President Trump is changing the look of Washington, D.C. He's resurfacing the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool in "American flag blue" and planning a triumphal arch. Some people say it's like treating the city as his personal country club.

articles.title: Your Dollar Is Shrinking! What a Weaker Buck Means for Your Wallet
articles.summary: The U.S. dollar has dropped about 10% since Trump took office. That makes vacations and imported stuff more expensive. Experts call it a "hidden tax."
